provenance: Except the Recycle Bin, every shape is a glyph of Fluent UI System Icons (Microsoft, MIT licence, https://github.com/microsoft/fluentui-system-icons, files `assets/<Name>/SVG/ic_fluent_<name>_<size>_<filled|regular>.svg`). The build recolours each glyph with a flat colour, scales it and places it; nothing else is changed. A "tone" pair is the filled glyph in a light colour under the regular (outline) glyph in a darker colour, which gives the two-tone look. The colours were picked by eye so that each icon resembles the Windows 11 icon of the same slot, compared side by side on a developer's machine. No Windows pixels, outlines or files were used, and no fonts. The Recycle Bin (ids 32 and 33) is the Tela icon theme's user-trash and user-trash-full SVG, edited as listed: its body is given a pale translucent fill and a visible outline, a darker base band is added, and its recycle symbol is recoloured blue; nothing else is changed. The land of the globes of ids 14, 15 and 18 is the Americas earth of Font Awesome Free 7.3.1 (Fonticons, Inc., CC BY 4.0, assets/iconpacks/src/fontawesome/), scaled into the globe and drawn in a light land colour.
